Deutsche -  Investment Company Report                    Report Date: 07/08/2004
Meeting Date Range: 07/01/2003 to 06/30/2004
Selected Accounts: Scudder S&P 500 Index Fund

Scudder  S&P 500 Index  Fund,  a series of  Investment  Trust,  is a feeder in a
master/feeder structure.  Accordingly,  S&P 500 Index Fund holds only securities
of its master fund, Scudder Equity 500 Index Portfolio.  Included in this filing
is the proxy voting record for the Scudder Equity 500 Index Portfolio.

ProxyEdge -  Investment Company Report                   Report Date: 07/19/2004
